summary.intent: Coordinate a set of parallel implementer subagents (seven in total) working in the callisto repo, including one fixing Python requirement idempotency in a parser.
summary.outcome: No work completed in this session slice. The Python parser agent returned only an interim notification while waiting on its own background work (likely a high-case proptest run). All seven implementers were still running, and the only recorded file change was crates/callisto-graph/src/error.rs.

repo: The callisto repo uses a Rust workspace with crates such as callisto-graph.
Subagents run in isolated git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/agent-<id>, each on its own worktree-agent-<id> branch.
Proptest is used in the repo, and high-case runs are slow enough that agents wait on them in the background.

code.finding: File was modified during the session, but the transcript gives no details or line numbers about the change.

workflow: A subagent can finish a turn with interim status while its own background work is still running; it later delivers its final report through SubagentHandback and the same task-id notifies again.
A completed-status notification with an interim result should not be treated as the final result; wait for the final report before acting.

friction: Repeated interim notifications from the Python parser agent gave no root cause or fix, so the coordinator had nothing to act on yet.
open_items: Await final reports from all seven implementer agents, including the Python requirement idempotency fix.
Review and merge the work from each agent's worktree branch once reports arrive.
Find out what change was made to crates/callisto-graph/src/error.rs and which agent made it.
